summary.text: Chris Bowen is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 69 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Jim Lucas and independent Tyler Henkle. She lives in Seymour and describes herself as an advocate and activist.

paragraphs.text: Chris Bowen is originally from Texas and, in a Ballotpedia survey, said she studied elementary education with a mathematics emphasis at Texas A&M University-Commerce before moving to Indiana nearly 20 years ago.

She said she lives in Seymour in a multigenerational household and has spent years in church service, community organizing and advocacy for children with special needs, the LGBTQ+ community, immigrants and working families.
Bowen advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.

She described her platform as a "Rural New Deal" that includes raising the minimum wage to a living wage, supporting Right to Repair for farmers, treating rural broadband as a public necessity, and holding corporate monopolies accountable.
She also said she would oppose cuts to health care coverage, invest in rural health infrastructure and cap prescription drug costs.
